description: This file defines the UpgraderController class within the OrangeHRM system, extending functionality from AbstractInstallerVueController. It manages the pre-rendering process for the upgrade screen in the installer, setting up GUI components and updating the state container.

classes.name: UpgraderController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing the upgrade process interface, specifically handling the pre-render setup for the upgrade screen.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Sets up the upgrade process screen component and updates the state container to reflect the current upgrade step.
